processing.smoothing: Two weighted 3x3 passes on decoded elevation values

processing.purpose: Illustrated travel-map context; contours are derived elevation data, not a recorded hiking track.

processing.coverage: Pitlochry, Craigower, Bealach na Searmoin, Killiecrankie and Loch Faskally; broad public geographic bounds only.
